description: Calendar Popup | Free Version is a date range picker custom visual for Microsoft Power BI. It replaces the standard slicer with a compact trigger button that, when clicked, expands into a full-month calendar popup. Users select a start and end date — or pick from a preset list — and the chosen range is pushed to the report as an advanced date filter. Intended audience ----------------- Report developers and BI analysts building Microsoft Power BI dashboards who need a clear, space-efficient, customizable date range filter. Useful for executive dashboards, finance and sales reports, operations monitoring, and any report where a small trigger button needs to expand into a richer date picker on demand. Value proposition ----------------- - Save space on dense report pages — the closed trigger occupies a single line; the calendar only appears when needed. - Provide a familiar calendar UI for end users (start date, end date, in-range highlight, today highlight) rather than relying on the default Power BI date slider. - Offer 18 built-in date presets including fiscal-year-aware presets (This Fiscal Year, Last Fiscal Year), week presets (Sun-Sat and Mon-Sun variants), and "All Dates Available" sourced from the bound column. - Support side-by-side period comparison via a second filter on a duplicate calendar table — for "this month vs. last month", "this year vs. last year", or any…
